'''RB-551''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] serving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One of the older [[Droid/Legends|units]] controlled by a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]], he was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
Created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="Databank" /> RB-551<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]<ref name="NEGTD" /> of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was one of the units in the line of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were controlled by a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]], a model that was considered old<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the Separatists [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and RB-551 was among the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that participated in the battle.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

[[File:RB-551.png|thumb|left|250px|RB-551's head was found by a droid patrol near the flatlands of Cazne.]]
At some point of the conflict, he was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] near<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> the cratered flatlands of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]],<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> the site of a major battle between the Confederacy and the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] led by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]. His remains were later found by a group of newer, independent-thinking model battle droids that were on the lookout for a missing patrol among the shattered hulks of Separatist [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|transports]] in that region. The droids reflected on RB-551's dependency on a central [[Computer/Legends|computer]], believing themselves to be superior to him; however, they were destroyed immediately thereafter by Syndulla and his freedom fighters.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

==Characteristics==
Programmed by a central computer, RB-551 was limited in his independent thinking.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Like all battle droids of his model, he stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]], 3 inches) tall,<ref name="TCWCE" /> weighed 65 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]<ref name="TCW H2H" /> had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|optical sensors]] and [[Bone/Legends|bone]]-white plating.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

==Behind the scenes==
RB-551 was first mentioned in a quote in the corresponding [[StarWars.com]] [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] for "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]," the twenty-first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which premiered on [[March 13]], [[2009]]. The quote described a scene not present in the originally aired cut of the episode, which featured RB-551.<ref name="Ep Guide" /> The scene was later released in the episode's "Director's Cut" version as part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] [[Star Wars home video releases#Star Wars The Clone Wars: Season One|DVD]] Collection,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> which was released on [[November 3]], 2009.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090715.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One on DVD and Blu-Ray}}</ref>
